metadata.provenance: Locally maintained subset verified against the official MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise v15 catalogue. It is not the complete STIX release.

techniques.name: Phishing
techniques.description: Adversaries may send phishing messages to gain access or information.

techniques.name: Phishing: Spearphishing Link
techniques.description: Adversaries may send spearphishing messages with a link to gain access.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
techniques.description: Adversaries may abuse command and script interpreters to execute commands.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell
techniques.description: Adversaries may abuse PowerShell commands and scripts for execution.

techniques.name: Process Discovery
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to get information about running processes.

techniques.name: Software Discovery: Security Software Discovery
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of security software.

techniques.name: System Information Discovery
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to get detailed information about the operating system and hardware.

techniques.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
techniques.description: Adversaries may exfiltrate data over an existing command and control channel.
